== Fields

=== `api_key`

Your API key for the Cohere API.

include::connect:components:partial$secret_warning.adoc[]

*Type*: `string`

=== `base_url`

The base URL to use for API requests.

*Type*: `string`

*Default*: `https://api.cohere.com`

=== `dimensions`

The number of dimensions (numerical values) in each vector embedding generated by this processor. This parameter only supports https://docs.cohere.com/v2/docs/embeddings[`embed-v4.0`^] and newer models. Possible values are `256`, `512`, `1024`, and `1536`.

*Type*: `int`

=== `input_type`

The type of text input passed to the model.

*Type*: `string`

*Default*: `search_document`

[cols="1m,2a"]
|===
|Option |Summary

|classification
|Used for embeddings passed through a text classifier.

|clustering
|Used for the embeddings run through a clustering algorithm.

|search_document
|Used for embeddings stored in a vector database for search use-cases.

|search_query
|Used for embeddings of search queries run against a vector DB to find relevant documents.

|===

=== `model`

The name of the Cohere model you want to use.

*Type*: `string`

[source,yaml]
----
# Examples:
model: embed-english-v3.0

# ---

model: embed-english-light-v3.0

# ---

model: embed-multilingual-v3.0

# ---

model: embed-multilingual-light-v3.0
----

=== `text_mapping`

The text you want to generate a vector embedding for. By default, the processor submits the entire payload as a string.

*Type*: `string`
